openQuestions.q: Does CHK-002 mean the Story-dispatch envelope itself gains a new signature authority, or only that review-run envelopes are authenticated through the signed ReviewRun?
openQuestions.evidence: The canonical plan says REVIEW Envelope belongs to the existing signed ReviewRun and that story-dispatch produces audit only, while CHK-002 userSees promises a signed envelope. A standalone signer would create the alternate authority the decision explicitly avoids.
